name: Polished Chrome Conical Table Lamp
description: A modern table lamp featuring a polished metallic finish, with a conical base flaring upwards and topped by a wide, shallow conical shade.

name: Sculptural Wavy Wood Floor Lamp with Drum Shade
description: A floor lamp featuring a tall, sculptural base crafted from solid wood, characterized by a prominent wavy or serpentine silhouette. It is topped with a neutral-colored cylindrical drum lampshade, providing ambient light. The wood has a dark, natural finish.

name: Mid-Century Modern Multi-Arm Chandelier with Sculptural Shades
description: A ceiling-mounted chandelier featuring a central brass downrod extending to a multi-arm structure. The frame consists of several gracefully curved brass arms, each terminating in a light socket with an exposed bulb. Each light source is accompanied by a distinctive, organically shaped, cream-colored shade that partially encloses the bulb, directing light and adding a sculptural element to the fixture. The overall design suggests a Mid-Century Modern aesthetic.

name: Brass and Frosted Fluted Glass Pendant Light
description: A close-up image of a pendant light featuring a brass fixture and a frosted, fluted glass shade with a scalloped edge. The light appears suspended, although no chain or cord is fully visible. The brass hardware connects to the top of the shade, which is opaque white and textured with vertical ridges, diffusing the light from an internal bulb.

name: Textured Knitted Fabric Pendant Light
description: A distinctive pendant light featuring an intricately textured shade, with an elongated upper section transitioning into a spherical lower section. The shade is crafted from a finely woven or knotted material, displaying a gradient from deep purple at the top to a golden-brown or tan at the illuminated bottom. The texture creates a patterned, tactile surface.

name: Bamboo-Style Floor Lamp with Pleated Shade
description: A tall floor lamp featuring a tapered, pleated fabric shade in an off-white color, supported by a slender metal stem designed with distinct bamboo-like nodes. The stem connects to a flat, round base with a subtle dish shape. The entire metal structure appears to have a bronze or antique brass finish.

name: Art Deco Domed Glass Table Lamp
description: A vintage or reproduction Art Deco style table lamp featuring a domed frosted glass shade with a distinctive geometric metal band, supported by a dark-finished metal stem and a round base.

name: Velvet Table Lamp
description: A contemporary table lamp featuring a broad, conical lampshade and a slender, tapered conical base, both upholstered in a deep red velvet fabric. The lamp is accented with polished brass elements at the foot of the base and connecting the shade to the base. A matching red fabric-covered power cord extends from the base, completing the cohesive design.

name: Modern Tapered Wood Base Table Lamp with Conical Shade
description: A modern table lamp featuring a solid wood base with a tapered, square pyramid-like shape, finished in a warm reddish-brown hue. It is topped with a wide, conical fabric lampshade in off-white, diffusing the light.

name: Modern Farmhouse Wood and Brass 8-Light Chandelier
description: A modern farmhouse style chandelier featuring a central turned light-toned wood body with eight curved antique brass arms. Each arm terminates in a candle-style bulb, resting on a small, round antique brass bobeche. The chandelier hangs from a matching antique brass chain and canopy.

name: Black Textured Spherical Base Floor Lamp with Ruffled Textile Shade
description: A striking black floor lamp featuring a sculptural base composed of stacked spherical elements of varying sizes and textures, culminating in a tiered, ruffled textile lampshade. The base consists of smooth matte black spheres interspersed with highly textured, porous-looking spheres, creating visual interest. The conical shade is made from a woven or crocheted material, forming multiple horizontal ruffles that add depth and a unique tactile quality to the light fixture. The overall design is monochromatic and presents a bold, contemporary aesthetic.

name: Modern Arc Floor Lamp with Wood and Frosted Glass Shade
description: A modern arc floor lamp featuring a dark-stained rectangular wooden column as its primary upright support. An arched metal arm, likely brushed nickel or brass, extends from the top of the wooden column, curving gracefully to suspend a horizontally oriented, elongated frosted glass shade. The base consists of a black-finished metal 'U' shaped support extending from the bottom of the wooden column, providing stability.

name: Modern Conical Table Lamp with Wood Base
description: A modern table lamp featuring a crisp white conical fabric shade, supported by a slender silver-toned metal stem. The stem emerges from a round, dark brown wooden base. A small, darker wooden detail and a flat metal disc are situated directly beneath the shade, adding subtle accents to the design.

name: Modern Minimalist Arc Floor Lamp
description: A modern minimalist floor lamp featuring a black conical base, a slender, arcing stem, and a spherical, diffused light source. A small sphere acts as a counterweight on the opposing end of the stem, maintaining balance and adding a design accent.

name: Contemporary Two-Tone Floor Lamp with Conical Fabric Shade
description: A contemporary floor lamp featuring a sage green conical fabric shade atop a slender two-tone stem, combining a matte olive green finish with polished brass accents. The lamp is supported by a round, flat polished brass base, and includes a white power cord extending from the base. The design is minimalist and elegant.

name: Sculptural Organic Floor Lamp with Fabric Shade
description: A tall, slender floor lamp featuring an organically shaped stem that transitions from a dark, root-like base to a golden, branch-like upper section, topped with a white fabric lampshade. The base is a dark rectangular plinth.

name: Tiered Brass and Glass Rod Chandelier
description: A multi-tiered chandelier featuring a circular, gold-toned metal frame adorned with numerous vertical glass rods. The design consists of three concentric rings, each progressively smaller towards the bottom, creating a cascading effect. The glass rods are clear, allowing light to pass through and refract, suggesting a luminous and elegant fixture.
